model: TROX UNIVERSAL room or duct pressure controller (EM-BAC-MOD-01, BACnet MS/TP)
aliases: order code PRS / PRE / PDS / PDE
applies_to: TROX TROX UNIVERSAL controllers set up as room or duct pressure controller, fitted with the EM-BAC-MOD-01 expansion module.
summary: TROX UNIVERSAL lab and room airflow controllers connect to BACnet MS/TP (or Modbus RTU) through the EM-BAC-MOD-01 expansion module. This is TROX's EDE file for the room or duct pressure controller (order code PRS / PRE / PDS / PDE): 45 value objects (18 AV, 26 BV, 1 MV). The MS/TP module has a much smaller object set than the EM-IP (BACnet IP) module, and some instance numbers differ.
notes: The module holds the objects of all applications; objects outside this application stay unused.
Units come from the EDE unit-code column; airflows are in l/s.
TROX ships identical EDE files for room pressure (PR*) and duct pressure (PD*) controllers; this one list covers both.

points.name: RoomModeAct
points.states: 1=No preset, 2=Standard Mode, 3=Low Mode, 4=High Mode, 5=Shut off Mode, 6=Open Mode

points.name: VolTotalExh
points.description: volume flow, total extract air value

points.name: VolTotalSup
points.description: volume flow, total supply air value

points.name: DampPos
points.description: damper, current position of the device

points.name: DampPosMax_RE
points.description: damper, max. position of all room extractors

points.name: DampPosMin_RE
points.description: damper, min. position of all room extractors

points.name: DampPosMax_TE
points.description: damper, max. position of all extractors (FH + EC + RE)

points.name: DampPosMin_TE
points.description: damper, min. position of all extractors (FH + EC + RE)

points.name: DampPosMax_RS
points.description: damper, max. position of all room suppliers

points.name: DampPosMin_RS
points.description: damper, min. position of all room suppliers

points.name: VolflowExh
points.description: extract airflow input from an external device

points.name: VolflowSup
points.description: supply airflow input from an external device

points.name: DampPosMax_TS
points.description: damper, max. position of all suppliers (SC + RS)

points.name: DampPosMin_TS
points.description: damper, min. position of all suppliers (SC + RS)

integration.summary: This application takes no mode preset over BACnet; the BMS mainly reads airflow, damper and alarm values; write AV 33 PressSet_R for the setpoint. Read MV 4 RoomModeAct, AV 2 VolflowAct, AV 3 VolTotalExh, AV 6 PressAct, BV 1 LocalAlarm.

minimum_points.name: PressSet_R
minimum_points.why: Room or duct pressure setpoint, Pa

minimum_points.name: RoomModeAct
minimum_points.why: Current operating mode of the room

minimum_points.name: PressAct
minimum_points.why: Measured room or duct pressure, Pa

integration.remote_sensors: AV 22 VolflowExh and AV 23 VolflowSup let the BMS feed extract and supply airflows of other equipment into the room balance.
setup: Default device instance is 32900 plus the network address set on hex switches X/Y.
MS/TP baud rate (9600, 19200, 38400 or 76800) is set on DIP switches 2 and 3; DIP 1 selects EASYLAB TCU3 or another controller.
Max_Master defaults to 127 and Max_Info_Frames to 1.
gotchas: If the network interface fails the airflow controller keeps controlling; only data exchange with the BMS stops.
